visualCharacteristics: Alternating image/text feature rows; image on one side paired side-by-side with a heading and paragraph on the other. Consecutive rows swap the image left/right. Stacks vertically on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per feature; each row has 2 cells (image cell and text cell). Rows alternate image/text order to reflect the left/right layout.
usage: Narrative feature sections that pair an image with descriptive copy, as opposed to repeatable uniform card items.
